rules.title: Unbounded find
rules.description: find() over large collections without limit() or batch control in a script — memory and runtime blowup.

rules.title: $where with JavaScript
rules.description: $where executing server-side JavaScript — slow (no index use) and dangerous with interpolated input. Use native operators.

rules.title: Unanchored regex query
rules.description: $regex without ^ anchor on an indexed field — full collection scan.

rules.title: Full-document fetch
rules.description: Queries returning whole documents when a few fields are needed — network and memory waste in scripts.
